task_reconstruction.official_task: 2024 MCM Problem C, momentum in tennis, addressed to coaches.
required_outputs: a measure of who is ahead during a match
a test of whether swings are random
a prediction of turning points and the factors behind them
a check on other matches, other surfaces, and other sports

section_map.summary: abstract: one final, then five moves from the index to the memo
introduction: a heated debate with two papers on each side
assumptions: ability fixed, ability inferred, serve favored
results: the final read set by set
model-establishment: a memoryless simulation and dynamic time warping
model-establishment: momentum labeled, then a forest and a hidden Markov model
results: three other matches, one of them missed
memo: four elements and five scenarios for coaches

contributions.summary: A match score, a player's strength, and the serve are put on one linear index.
The classifier's probability is used and its class label is refused.
Momentum is tested by building a match that has none.
The importance of a point is the change it makes in the chance of winning the match.

dependency_graph.label: Strength and serve feed the simulation.
The forest's state is where the HMM starts.
Leverage is a difference of performance.

assumptions.summary: Ability stays constant during a match, so variation is the opponent or the conditions.
Ability can be read out of the match file.
The server has an advantage. The paper calls this foundational.
A match with no momentum is a random score that still follows the rules.

data_and_preprocessing.summary: speed_mph and rally_count are filled with medians. Strength analysis drops every performance indicator.
The worst gaps are matches 1310 and 1311, and the serve speeds of Guido Pella and Mikael Ymer.
The appendix lists seventeen forest inputs after the body claims fifteen.

models.summary: MU-C-Q244-001: dynamic play index from performance, strength, and serve.
MU-C-Q244-002: memoryless simulation compared by dynamic time warping.
MU-C-Q244-003: random forest on a three-way momentum label.
MU-C-Q244-004: one hidden Markov model per match, plus situational leverage.

verification.summary: Boosting accuracy 82.4 percent on the final.
Six of seven matches favor model I. Rublev against Djokovic does not separate.
Held-out accuracies 0.83, 0.85, and 0.58. The last had no HMM.
Noise on two indicators lowers recall slightly. The summary says accuracy falls 8 percent.

results_trace.summary: Final, match 1701, 334 points, five sets, read one by one.
Indicator order: consecutive scores, rally count, distance run, winner, ace.

writing_logic.summary: The summary counts five moves and names the memo's audience.
Each side of the debate gets two citations.
The test is stated as an assumption and the observation that would kill it.
A second model is justified by one word of the task.
The memo concedes the court surface and calls it future work.

language_observations.summary: Witnessed, also sparking debates. First, then, after that, next, finally. Thus, We yield.
It's noteworthy that although. Stand out for their precision, thus validating.
Except for. Fail to accurately represent, thereby substantiating.
It seems that the task can be fully accomplished. However, the word inspires us.
Not only a tool but a cornerstone. You are the architect. Warm regards.

visualization_observations.summary: A figure standing in for the whole of section 1.3, whose title is printed Ourwork.
Missing-value counts. The worst gaps are matches 1310 and 1311, and the serve speeds of Guido Pella and Mikael Ymer.
The boosting diagram the prose says the reader can see.
Alcaraz performance against the cumulative score, bold above 0.5.
DPI of the final, read set by set, orange against blue.
DTW paths and total distances for seven matches. The random paths leave the diagonal.
HMM diagram. The transitions are said to be missing from it and essential anyway.

Turning points for the men's match 1602.

judge_relevance_hypotheses.summary: The paper reports the one match its test does not separate, which is the honest part of an otherwise overclaimed proof.
The memo answers the coaches the problem asks for, and it keeps one limitation.

weaknesses.summary: The summary says similarity closer to 50 percent. The body never prints 50 percent.
Momentum is called binary and then given three states. The threshold omega has no value.
The heading says 2020 US Open and the table says 2023. The summary's 8 percent is not the body's small drop.
Fifteen variables are claimed and the appendix lists seventeen.

independent_extensions.summary: Add court surface and altitude as inputs, which the paper names after the US Open miss and does not fit.
Publish the threshold omega and refit the label, so the three-way momentum can be rebuilt.

candidate_rule_impacts.summary: Open on one match and the debate it started.
State the assumption and the observation that would kill it.
